resources.string: Enter your gold details below to calculate the zakat amount based on current gold value.
Fill in the details and click calculate.
- Keep: Gold weight exceeds 85g is taxable.\n- Wear: Gold weight exceeds 200g is taxable.\n- Zakat rate is 2.5% of the taxable amount.

Application Name: Zakat Gold Calculator

Developer: Nurin 'Aqilah binti Rahmat
Student Number: 2025747583
Programme Code: CDCS251
Group: CDCS2515A

This application is developed to estimate zakat payment for gold keeping and wearing based on gold weight, gold type, and current gold value per gram.
